Computational core 95-100% (qlike_torch/rvx_features 100%, spillover 96%, adjacency_ops 98%, build_report 94%, analyze 83%); shortfall is sweep.py GPU orchestration (run_all/main/build_backbone_path/load_backbone/_spillover_static/_run_config_for_seed) — run entry points exercised end-to-end by the real 5-config x 3-seed GPU sweep (evidence: results/beat_har_*_2026-08-10_0130/), outside unit scope per repo convention

result_summary: Documented NULL: no config DM-significantly beats P0 pooled-HAR anchor (test QLIKE 0.5676). C2 (HAR+additive graph residual) statistically ties P0 on QLIKE (paired-t p=0.562) and RMSE; C1 (QLIKE-loss GAT+news) ties P0 on RMSE, worse on QLIKE; C3 (spillover), C5 (spillover+omit-self k-sweep), C6 (learned adjacency) worse on QLIKE. C4 (HAR-RV-X) deferred (needs 6-feature backbone via pilot preprocessor change), C7 (news-as-edge) infeasible (per-ticker panel, no multi-ticker structure). 5 configs x 3 seeds x 20 epochs on the consistent fair basis; leakage-safe.
